title: LobsterPay
summary: Give an AI agent a policy-capped token vault: allow-list a merchant, fund fees, and let the agent pay exactly once within its limits.
what: LobsterPay is an Anchor 0.31.1 vault for agent payments. The owner creates a vault and a policy with per-transaction and daily caps plus allow-lists for mints and destinations. An authorized agent calls execute_pay_exact; the program checks every rule, pays the destination from the vault ATA, takes a 1.5% service fee, and refunds the agent's network fee from a separate SOL fee vault.
app_note: The page at /dapps/lobsterpay/ is the generic IDL-driven wallet console. The lab tree is branch sol-college-devnet of Blockchains/lobsterpay. The lab only changed declare_id to a unique lab program.

try_steps.do: Open /dapps/lobsterpay/, switch to Devnet, and connect a wallet. The lab already ran the full pay flow.

diagram: owner --initialize_vault--> vault+policy; owner --update_policy--> allow-lists; owner --deposit_fees--> fee_vault; agent --execute_pay_exact--> merchant ATA (+net), treasury ATA (+1.5%), fee refund to agent.
innovation: Spending rules live on-chain next to the funds, so a compromised agent key can only pay allow-listed destinations within the caps.
exercises: Which check fires first if the agent pays a stranger more than the cap?
How is the 1.5% fee computed and rounded?
